paite: Simon Peter, Jesu Khrist sikha leh sawltak in, i Pathian leh Hondampa Jesu Khrist diktatna ziak a ginna manphatak i tan bang tang samte kiang ah:
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

paite: Pathian leh Jesu i Toupa theihna ah hehpihna leh khamuanna noute ah hihkhan in om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

paite: Ama thupina leh hoihna ziak a hon sampa, atanchin theih ziak in ama Pathianna thilhihtheihna in hinna leh Pathian limsakna lam thu ah thil tengteng ahon peta hi.
heading: Pathian Sapna Leh Telna
english: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

paite: Huaite ziak in athuchiam manphatak leh thupi mahmahte ahon pia hi; huchi in utna ziak a khovel a siatna hong om taikhiaksan in; huai thuchiam manphatak leh thupi mahmahte ziak in Pathian omdan na kikoppih thei sam ding uhi.
english: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

paite: Ahi, huaiziak tak in, thanop himhim suah in, na ginna uah hoihna hel unla, na hoihna uah theihna hel unla,
heading: Khristian Omdan Kilawm
english: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

paite: na theihna uah kidekna hel unla, na kidekna uah kuhkalna hel unla, na kuhkalna uah Pathian limsakna hel unla,
english: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

paite: na Pathian limsakna uah unaute itna hel unla, na unaute itna ah itna hel un.
english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

paite: Hiai hoihnate nou a ahih a, akhan zelleh i Toupa Jesu Khrist theihna lam ah thadah lou leh gah lou lou in nou ahon bawl ding hi.
english: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Kuapeuh huai thilte nei lou mittaw, naichikte kia mu thei, anidanglai khelhnate siansakna mangngilhte ahi uhi.
english: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

paite: Huaiziak in unaute aw, nou ahon sapna leh ahon telna hihkip ding in thanop suah semsem un; huaite na hih uleh chik lai mah in na puk kei ding uhi.
english: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

paite: Huchi in Jesu Khrist i Toupa leh Hondampa'n tangtawn gam a lutna ahon musak lo mahmah ding hi.
english: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in huai thilte nei in na kiang ua om thutak a phuhkip hita mah le uchin, huai thutak mah ka hon theisak nawn ding hi.
heading: Thutak A Kiphuhkipna
english: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

paite: Huan hiai pumpi a ka om lai teng noumau hon theihpih in hon tohhalh gige hoih ka sa hi.
english: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist in hon theihsak bang in ka pumpi puanin koihkhiak hun ding hong tung pah ding chih ka thei hi.
english: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

paite: Ahi ka paikhiak nung in huai thilte na theihgigena ding un ka kisuk ding hi.
english: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist thilhihtheihna leh ahong paina thu ka hon theihsak lai un, tangthu piltak a ngaihtuahkhiak phet zui ka hi kei ua, athupina mute ka hi zaw uhi.
heading: Zawlneite Leh Peter Theihpihna / (Mat 17.5; Mar 9.7; Luk 9.52)
english: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

paite: Ama'n Pa Pathian kiang a kipan in pahtawina leh thupina amu a, huchih lai in thupina thupitak a kipan in hichibang aw akiang ahong tung hi, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi," chi in.
english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

paite: Huan tang siangthou a akiang a ka om ziak un huai aw van a kipan a hong suak koumau ngei in ka za uhi.
english: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

paite: Huchi in genkholhna thu kip nawn sem i nei uhi. Khua ahong vak a, zingsol aksi na lungtang ua ahong suah masiah hiai thu khawnvak mun mial a vak alimsak bang ua, na limsak uleh na hihhoih ding uhi.
english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

paite: Laisiangthou a thugenkholh himhim eimah kihilhchet ding ahi kei chih thei masa un.
english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

paite: Thugenkholh himhim mihing thu a pawt ahi ngei kei a, mite'n Kha Siangthou sawl in, Pathian a kipan agen zaw uhi.
english: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
